notes.title: Update 2021.12.0
notes.content:
What's new?
New Speedrun challenge - Speed 1
The challenge focuses on high-speed movement. Make sure to collect every speed buff!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41158409/1a7aff759309db6724e77197b95c3e4d173bd7d3.gif

Added six new Achievements

Smaller Bug Fixes


What's next?

The next updates will occur less frequently as we decided to release the demo of our single-player game USS Tempest: Spaceship Simulator at the next Steam Game Festival (earlier than planned). Me Vs You will be our only Early Access game and the phase gets extended accordingly as we have major plans for next year.

Enjoy Christmas and New Year, stay awesome!

notes.title: Halloween Update 2021.10.1 - Two New Modes - Red Light, Green Light and Hunted
notes.content:
New Encounter Mode - Red Light, Green Light
Our interpretation of Squid Game's "Red Light, Green Light" is fully available now. Reach the finish line and don't move when the clown's eyes are red. Avoid the obstacles on the field and don't forget to move in case the head turns and the light stays green!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41158409/412f44dde369657ae71a9a5fd1451123d744fec7.gif

New Shooting Range Mode - Hunted
Tired of shooting at static targets? In this new mode you have to watch your back as you will become the hunted one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41158409/e5ec756d409771bd6c96ec7b220b136f2fd6696d.gif

Enjoy Halloween!

The next content update is scheduled for the mid of October. Planned is to improve the Leaderboard integration and to add a Timing Challenge. Don't forget to participate in the Launch Competition. No one claimed the World First yet!

notes.title: Early Access Release Competition - Speedrun Pro World First
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

let's celebrate the Early Access Launch with a competition! Make sure to check out how to claim the Speedrun Pro world first on the website before you start the attempts!

What's next?
The next small content update is scheduled for the end of next week.  Please remember that your input is very important during the Early Access. We'll try to make hotfixes as fast as possible for everything you report!

Have fun and don't Rage Quit!
